nodes.label: desktop memory - do not stop a push to ask about benchmark data

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. Do not stop a git commit or push workflow to ask whether benchmark or evaluation datasets look like real company data. Both the HERB (Salesforce) and Bonnier datasets in this repo are synthetic or public benchmark data created to look like enterprise data, which is the point of the dataset, so flagging them as sensitive before pushing is wrong and breaks the flow. The trigger: the user was frustrated when a push was halted to ask about Bonnier CSVs. When staging and pushing untracked files, include all data files in the data subdirectories except those already gitignored, without pausing to ask about privacy
